source_title: Entertainment 'I Used To Respect Him': Kiren Rijiju Slams Naseeruddin Shah Over 'Dimagi Naxal' Remark, Calls Him 'Dangerous'
source_excerpt:
Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has criticised veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah after the latter described himself as a "Dimagi Naxal" and part of the "tukde-tukde gang". Rijiju said he had once respected the actor but was unaware of what he called Shah's "dangerous" views, escalating the political row over the actor's remarks.
The controversy centres on Shah's backing of students at Jamia Millia Islamia in Delhi, who have been demanding the restoration of students' union. His comments have also drawn criticism from Bharatiya Janata Party leaders and some members of the film fratenity.

Reacting to Shah's video, Rijiju took to social media to express his displeasure. The Union Minister said he had previously respected the actor but had not known about what he described as his "dangerous" views.
“I thought Naseeruddin Shah was just an ordinary actor. I used to respect & like him. I never knew that he was a dangerous urban Dimagi Naxal!”
He added, " Mujhe uske asli charitra ke baare mai bahut der se pata chala. Bharat ke loktantra ke liye atyant haanikarak hai.” [I found out about his true character very late. He is extremely harmful to Indian democracy.]
I thought Naseeruddin Shah was just an ordinary actor. I used to respect & like him.. I never knew that he was a dangerous urban Dimagi Naxal ! मुझे उसके असली चरित्र के बारे में बहुत देर से पता चला।। भारत के लोकतंत्र के लिए अत्यंत हानिकारक है। https://t.co/McSDNBJjPt
The term “Dimagi Naxal” has been used by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other ruling party leaders to target people they accuse of supporting Maoist ideology despite their education and social standing.
ALSO READ: 'That Shame I Will Always Carry': Janhvi Kapoor Admits 'Peddi' Objectified Her Character, Says It Weighs On Her Conscience
Shah’s remarks came in a video posted on Facebook on Tuesday, in which he voiced support for Jamia Millia Islamia students protesting for the restoration of their students’ union. Wearing a badge bearing the words “Dimagi Naxal”, the actor criticised the BJP-led government at the Centre and challenged the authorities to take action against him.
“I proudly declare that I am Dimagi Naxal. I don't know what other nicknames the watchmen have given to people like me, anti-national, tukde tukde gang, and I don't know what else,” Shah said.
“ Pehle Jawaharlal Nehru University, fir Satyajit Ray Film Institute aur ab Jamia Millia mein jo chaatron pe zulum kiya jaa raha hai woh yaad rakha jaayega [The atrocities being committed on students first at Jawaharlal Nehru University, then at Satyajit Ray Film Institute and now at Jamia Millia Islamia will be remembered.]”

केंद्रीय मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने दिग्गज अभिनेता नसीरुद्दीन शाह के हालिया बयानों को लेकर उनकी आलोचना की है। रिजिजू ने कहा कि वह पहले अभिनेता का सम्मान करते थे, लेकिन अब उन्होंने शाह के विचारों को खतरनाक बताया है।

### विवाद की पृष्ठभूमि

यह विवाद नसीरुद्दीन शाह द्वारा फेसबुक पर साझा किए गए एक वीडियो के बाद सामने आया है, जिसमें उन्होंने "दिमागी नक्सल" लिखा हुआ एक बैज पहना था। वीडियो में अभिनेता ने दिल्ली स्थित जामिया मिल्लिया इस्लामिया के छात्रों का समर्थन किया, जो छात्र संघ की बहाली की मांग कर रहे हैं। शाह ने केंद्र सरकार की आलोचना भी की और जवाहरलाल नेहरू विश्वविद्यालय तथा सत्यजीत रे फिल्म संस्थान के विरोध प्रदर्शनों का जिक्र किया।

### प्रतिक्रियाएं और राजनीतिक संदर्भ

* रिजिजू ने सोशल मीडिया पर लिखा कि वह पहले शाह को पसंद करते थे और उनका सम्मान करते थे, लेकिन उन्हें अभिनेता के असली चरित्र का बहुत देर से पता चला और उन्होंने इसे लोकतंत्र के लिए हानिकारक बताया।
* "दिमागी नक्सल" शब्द का इस्तेमाल पहले भी सत्ताधारी पार्टी के नेताओं द्वारा आलोचकों के लिए किया जाता रहा है।
* शाह की टिप्पणियों पर भारतीय जनता पार्टी के नेताओं और फिल्म जगत के कुछ सदस्यों की ओर से भी प्रतिक्रियाएं आई हैं.

### सत्यता की जांच कैसे करें

पाठक राजनीतिक हस्तियों के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल और मनोरंजन जगत की खबरों को कवर करने वाली समाचार एजेंसियों की सत्यापित रिपोर्टों के माध्यम से इन बयानों की जांच कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has publicly criticised veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah following remarks the actor made in a recent video. Rijiju stated that he had previously respected the actor but expressed concern over what he described as dangerous views.

### Background of the Controversy

The dispute follows a video posted by Shah on Facebook, where he wore a badge bearing the phrase "Dimagi Naxal." In the video, the actor voiced support for students at Jamia Millia Islamia in Delhi who are demanding the restoration of a students' union. Shah also criticised the central government and referenced past protests at Jawaharlal Nehru University and the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute.

### Reactions and Political Context

* Rijiju posted on social media that he previously liked and respected Shah, but claimed he learned of the actor's views late, calling them harmful to Indian democracy.
* The term "Dimagi Naxal" has previously been used by ruling party figures to describe critics with educated or urban backgrounds.
* Shah's comments have drawn additional criticism from Bharatiya Janata Party leaders and certain members of the film community.

### How to Verify

Readers can verify public statements by reviewing official social media handles of political figures and verified statements released by news agencies covering the entertainment industry and political reactions.
